{{Quote|We hear you, rocketjock. We aren't a mind to do that. |An unidentified prisoner responds to [[Villian Dance]]'s order to turn back to the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].|<ref name="Death Star" />}}
Alongside 15 other prisoners from the [[prison]] [[planet]] [[Despayre]], an unidentified '''prisoner''' piloted a stolen [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] in an attempt to escape to the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Minimum Safe Distance]]. However, before they could reach it, [[Lieutenant]] [[Villian Dance]] shot apart the ship, killing all the prisoners inside.<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
